answer.action: Ensure compliance with the finalized instructions on novation of OTC derivative contracts incorporated into the respective Master Directions.
answer.action_quote: the instructions related to the OTC derivative contracts have been finalised.

effective_date.quote: The instructions shall be applicable to any novation undertaken on or after the date of issue of this circular.

answer.amends: Master Direction – Risk Management and Inter -Bank Dealings dated July 05, 2016
